theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 48 群

items.pos: adj. 整潔的 | v. 整理
items.colloc: tidy up 收拾 | keep tidy 保持整潔
items.distinct: neat 整齊的 | clean 乾淨的
ex: Please keep your workspace tidy at all times.
請隨時保持你的工作空間整潔。
I need to tidy up these files before the meeting.
開會前我需要整理一下這些檔案。
The office looks very tidy after the renovation.
翻修後辦公室看起來非常整潔。

items.colloc: take a vacation 去度假 | paid vacation 有薪假
items.distinct: holiday 節日；假期 | leave 請假
ex: She is planning to take a vacation next month.
她計畫下個月去度假。
Our company offers three weeks of paid vacation.
我們公司提供三週的有薪假。
All employees are eligible for annual vacation.
所有員工都有資格享有年度休假。

items.colloc: on the wall 在牆上 | office wall 辦公室隔間
items.distinct: partition 分隔板 | fence 圍籬
ex: There is a new company logo on the wall.
牆上有一個新的公司標誌。
The soundproofing of this wall is quite good.
這面牆的隔音效果相當好。
Please do not hang heavy items on the wall.
請不要將重物掛在牆上。

items.colloc: at the wheel 駕駛中 | steering wheel 方向盤
items.distinct: tire 輪胎 | rim 輪圈
ex: The delivery cart has a broken wheel.
送貨推車有一個輪子壞了。
Check if every wheel is locked before moving.
移動前請檢查每個輪子是否已鎖定。
Replacing the wheel will take about ten minutes.
更換輪子大約需要十分鐘。

items.pos: adj. 極度渴望的；孤注一擲的
items.colloc: desperate need 極度需求 | desperate attempt 拼命嘗試
items.distinct: eager 急切的 | hopeless 無望的
ex: The department is in desperate need of staff.
部門極度需要人手。
Management made a desperate attempt to cut costs.
管理層為了削減成本做了最後的嘗試。
He is desperate to finish the report tonight.
他非常渴望今晚完成報告。

items.colloc: ceiling fan 天花板風扇 | big fan 死忠粉絲
items.distinct: ventilator 通風設備 | enthusiast 熱衷者
ex: The ceiling fan is making a strange noise.
天花板風扇發出了奇怪的聲音。
I am a big fan of this software update.
我是這個軟體更新的忠實愛好者。
Please turn on the fan to improve ventilation.
請打開風扇以改善通風。

items.colloc: normal business hours 正常營業時間 | back to normal 恢復正常
items.distinct: regular 規律的 | standard 標準的
ex: Operations will return to normal next week.
業務下週將會恢復正常。
This level of traffic is normal for Monday.
這種交通流量在週一是很正常的。
Please work within normal business hours.
請在正常的營業時間內工作。

items.pos: v. 忍受；負擔 | n. 熊
items.colloc: bear the cost 負擔費用 | bear in mind 記住
items.distinct: endure 持久忍受 | tolerate 寬容
ex: The company will bear the cost of training.
公司將負擔培訓費用。
Please bear in mind the deadline is Friday.
請記住截止日期是週五。
I cannot bear the noise in this office.
我無法忍受辦公室裡的噪音。

items.colloc: in principle 原則上 | ethical principle 道德準則
items.distinct: principal 主要的；校長 | rule 規則
ex: We agree to the proposal in principle.
我們原則上同意這項提案。
The machine works on a simple principle.
這台機器是根據簡單的原理運作。
Adhering to principles is crucial for leadership.
堅持原則對領導力至關重要。

items.colloc: express disapproval 表達不滿 | show disapproval 表現出反對
items.distinct: disagreement 不同意 | objection 反對
ex: The manager showed clear disapproval of the plan.
經理對該計畫表現出明顯的不滿。
Public disapproval forced a change in strategy.
大眾的不滿迫使策略做出改變。
She expressed her disapproval during the meeting.
她在會議中表達了她的不贊成。

items.colloc: poor quality 品質低劣 | poor performance 表現不佳
items.distinct: weak 虛弱的 | inferior 次等的
ex: The project failed due to poor planning.
由於計畫不周，該專案失敗了。
This product has a reputation for poor quality.
這個產品以品質低劣聞名。
Her poor performance led to a formal review.
她表現不佳導致了正式考核。

items.pos: v. 驚嚇 | n. 恐慌
items.colloc: scare off 嚇跑 | market scare 市場恐慌
items.distinct: frighten 使害怕 | terrify 使恐懼
ex: High prices might scare off potential buyers.
高價可能會嚇跑潛在的買家。
The sudden announcement caused a market scare.
突如其來的公告引起了市場恐慌。
We do not want to scare the new staff.
我們不想嚇到新進員工。

items.pos: n. 指揮；命令 | v. 指揮
items.colloc: in command of 指揮 | command attention 吸引注意
items.distinct: order 命令 | authority 權威
ex: He is in command of the marketing department.
他負責指揮行銷部門。
The CEO commands great respect from staff.
執行長受到員工的高度尊重。
The software uses a simple voice command.
該軟體使用簡單的語音指令。

items.colloc: face opposition 面臨反對 | in opposition to 與...對立
items.distinct: resistance 抵抗 | objection 反對意見
ex: The new policy faced strong opposition from workers.
新政策面臨員工的強烈反對。
There is some opposition to the merger plan.
對於合併計畫存在一些反對聲音。
He stood in opposition to the current management.
他站在現行管理層的對立面。

items.pos: n. 螢幕 | v. 篩選
items.colloc: computer screen 電腦螢幕 | screen candidates 篩選候選人
items.distinct: monitor 顯示器 | filter 過濾器
ex: Please clean the screen after your shift.
請在輪班後清潔螢幕。
Human resources will screen all incoming resumes.
人力資源部會篩選所有收到的履歷。
The screen is too small for data analysis.
這個螢幕對於數據分析來說太小了。

items.colloc: valuable asset 有價值的資產 | valuable feedback 寶貴意見
items.distinct: invaluable 無價的 | expensive 昂貴的
ex: Your feedback is valuable to our improvement.
你的意見對我們的改善很有價值。
This data is a valuable asset for research.
這份數據是研究的重要資產。
She gained valuable experience from the internship.
她從實習中獲得了寶貴的經驗。

items.pos: adj. 代理的 | n. 演戲
items.colloc: acting manager 代理經理 | acting director 代理董事
items.distinct: temporary 暫時的 | substitute 替代的
ex: She is serving as the acting manager now.
她目前擔任代理經理。
The acting director will lead the meeting.
代理董事將主持這次會議。
He took the acting role during the vacancy.
在職位空缺期間，他接任了代理職務。

items.colloc: adapt to 適應 | adapt to change 適應變化
items.distinct: adjust 調整 | adopt 採用
ex: We must adapt to the changing market conditions.
我們必須適應不斷變化的市場狀況。
It takes time to adapt to a new job.
適應新工作需要時間。
The software was adapted for mobile use.
該軟體已針對行動裝置進行修改。

items.colloc: well adapted 適應良好的 | adapted from 改編自
items.distinct: modified 修改過的 | adjusted 調整過的
ex: The plant is well adapted to dry climates.
這種植物非常適應乾燥氣候。
This report is adapted from the original data.
這份報告是從原始數據改編而來的。
He is well adapted to the office culture.
他非常適應辦公室文化。

items.colloc: widely admired 廣受欽佩 | much admired 非常受讚賞
items.distinct: respected 受尊重的 | popular 受歡迎的
ex: She is a widely admired leader in tech.
她是科技界廣受欽佩的領導者。
His work is admired by all his colleagues.
他的工作受到所有同事的讚賞。
The company has an admired reputation for service.
該公司在服務方面享有令人欽佩的聲譽。
